q: Stripe 类支付系统的核心功能需求包括哪些？（多选）
options: 商户发行股票和期权
商户创建 PaymentIntent 发起收款
用户用信用卡/借记卡付款
商户查看支付状态更新
why: 主线是创建支付意图、处理卡支付、暴露状态；退款、订阅、钱包和 payout 都可以放到范围外。
why_en: The core path is creating a payment intent, processing card payments, and exposing payment status, while refunds and subscriptions stay out of scope.
options_en: The merchant issues company stock and options.
The merchant creates a PaymentIntent to request a charge.
The customer pays with a credit or debit card.
The merchant can view payment status updates.
q_en: Which core functional requirements belong in a Stripe-like payment system? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: 发行股票期权是公司融资行为，和收款流程没有关系，不该出现在支付系统的核心需求里。
创建 PaymentIntent 是发起收款的第一步，后续所有支付动作都围绕它展开。
客户用卡完成实际扣款，是收款流程里唯一真正移动资金的一步。
商户查看支付状态，让商户知道该发货还是该重试，是收款闭环里必不可少的一环。
optionExplanations_en: Issuing stock and options is corporate financing, not a checkout flow, so it doesn't belong in the payment system's core requirements.
Creating a PaymentIntent is the first step of a charge, and every later payment action refers back to it.
The customer paying by card is the one step in the flow that actually moves money.
Letting merchants view payment status tells them whether to ship or retry, closing the loop on the charge.
scenario: 为 Stripe 类支付平台裁 MVP 范围：只做卡收款闭环，退款、订阅、payout 全部推到 v2。
scenario_en: We're scoping the MVP of a Stripe-like platform: card checkout only, with refunds, subscriptions and payouts pushed to v2.

q: 支付系统峰值 10k+ TPS 且促销会突发，最直接支持哪项设计判断？
options: 10k TPS 太小，不需要考虑扩展
Kafka 需要多分区、数据库需要分片等水平扩展手段
可以用单机 MySQL 顶住所有写入无需分片
所有服务都应该保持有状态以简化设计
why: TPS 是每秒事务数；10k+ TPS 表示峰值时每秒有一万多次支付相关事务。这个量级会推动 Kafka 多分区、数据库分片和弹性扩容。
why_en: TPS means transactions per second; 10k-plus TPS is a scale anchor that drives Kafka partitioning, database sharding, and elastic scaling decisions.
tradeoff: 单机简单性 vs 水平扩展能力
whenOtherWins: 若只是内部低频支付后台，单库和少量 worker 可能足够；这里的促销峰值要求先预留水平扩展路径。
scenario: 面试官给出：支付系统峰值约 10,000+ TPS（每秒一万多次支付相关事务），且节假日促销会有突发流量。
options_en: 10k TPS is too small to require any scaling work.
Kafka needs multiple partitions and the database needs sharding to scale horizontally.
A single MySQL instance can absorb all writes without sharding.
Every service should keep local state to simplify the design.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒事务数：这里指系统每秒处理的支付创建、确认、状态变更等支付相关事务量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TPS, or transactions per second, is how many payment-related transactions the system processes each second.

termDefinitions.meaning: Kafka 分区：把同一个 topic 拆成多个有序日志，让消费者可以并行处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Kafka partition is one ordered log inside a topic, allowing parallel consumption across partitions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库分片：把数据按商户、支付意图等键拆到多个数据库节点，分摊写入压力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Database sharding splits data across nodes by a key such as merchant or payment intent to spread write load.

q_en: What design decision is most supported by a 10k-plus TPS peak with promotion bursts?
scenario_en: The interviewer gives a payment system peak of about 10,000-plus TPS, with holiday promotions creating sudden traffic bursts.
optionExplanations: 把 10k+ TPS 当成小流量会让促销峰值直接打穿数据库和队列，这个量级必须提前做水平扩展设计。
让 Kafka 按多个 partition 并行、数据库按 shard 分散写，两边都留扩展余量，才扛得住促销时的峰值。
单机 MySQL 只有量级远低于此时才够用；10k+ TPS 下它会变成写入热点和单点故障。
让服务保留本地状态会让扩容和故障切换更难，支付服务这种量级更适合无状态水平扩容。
optionExplanations_en: Treating a 10k-plus TPS peak as trivial leaves databases and queues exposed once a promotion bursts, so this scale needs scaling designed in up front.
Running Kafka with several parallel partitions and spreading database writes across shards gives both legs headroom for a promotion peak.
A single MySQL instance only holds up at far lower volume; at 10k-plus TPS it becomes a write hotspot and single point of failure.
Keeping local state on services makes scaling and failover harder; at this volume payment services scale better staying stateless.

q: 支付系统高层建模中哪些实体是核心？（多选）
options: Merchant，存商户身份、配置和 API key
GameMove，记录棋局走子
PaymentIntent，跟踪一次收款意图的生命周期
Transaction，表示一次具体 money movement/charge attempt
why: Merchant、PaymentIntent、Transaction 足够支撑商户 API、支付流程和状态查询；其他金融对象可后续拆分。
why_en: Merchant, PaymentIntent, and Transaction capture merchant access, payment lifecycle, and concrete money movement.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  M[Merchant]
  PI[Payment Intent]
  T[Transaction]
  N[Payment Network]
  M --> PI
  PI --> T
  T --> N
options_en: Merchant stores business identity, config, and API keys.
GameMove records a move in a board game.
PaymentIntent tracks the lifecycle of one payment intention.
Transaction represents one concrete money-movement or charge attempt.

termDefinitions.meaning: 代表一次收款意图，跟踪从创建到完成的生命周期。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A PaymentIntent represents a merchant's intent to collect a payment and tracks its lifecycle.

termDefinitions.meaning: 代表一次具体的资金移动或扣款尝试，归属于某个 PaymentIntent。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Transaction represents one concrete money-movement attempt tied to a PaymentIntent.

q_en: Which entities are core in the high-level payment-system model? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: Merchant 存商户身份、配置和 API key，是发起收款和鉴权都要用到的基础实体。
GameMove 是棋类游戏的走子记录，跟支付系统的收款、结算完全不搭边。
PaymentIntent 跟踪一次收款意图从创建到成功/失败的完整生命周期。
Transaction 记录一次具体的资金移动或扣款尝试，归属于某个 PaymentIntent。
optionExplanations_en: Merchant holds business identity, config, and API keys — the base entity every charge and auth check relies on.
GameMove records a board-game move; it has nothing to do with charging or settling a payment.
PaymentIntent tracks one charge's lifecycle from creation through success or failure.
Transaction records one concrete money-movement attempt tied back to a PaymentIntent.
scenario: 支付平台第一版只需支撑商户 API、发起一次收款和状态查询，实体模型要尽量少。
scenario_en: The first version only needs to support the merchant API, starting a charge, and status lookups, so the entity model stays minimal.

q: PaymentIntent 和 Transaction 的核心区别是什么？
options: Transaction 是用户账号，PaymentIntent 是商户账号
PaymentIntent 和 Transaction 必须严格一一对应，不能重试
PaymentIntent 管收款生命周期，Transaction 记录资金移动尝试
PaymentIntent 只用于 webhook，不存数据库
why: 一个 PaymentIntent 可关联多次 Transaction，例如失败重试、部分支付或退款扩展；商户看到的是更简单的整体状态。
why_en: A PaymentIntent owns the payment lifecycle while Transactions represent concrete attempts or money movements under it.
options_en: Transaction is the customer account and PaymentIntent is the merchant account.
PaymentIntent and Transaction must map one-to-one and can never be retried.
PaymentIntent owns the payment lifecycle; Transaction records each money-movement attempt.
PaymentIntent is only used for webhooks and is never stored in the database.
tradeoff: 生命周期视图 vs 具体尝试记录
q_en: What is the core difference between a PaymentIntent and a Transaction?
optionExplanations: 误将两个支付流程实体当成账号：Transaction 不是用户账号，PaymentIntent 也不是商户账号。
误以为一一对应：卡失败重试三次会挂出三条尝试记录，商户状态页仍只显示一个结果。
生命周期和具体尝试要分开看：PaymentIntent 管收款全程状态，Transaction 记录每次资金移动尝试。
作为持久化核心记录，PaymentIntent 要写入数据库，并不是只服务于 webhook 的一次性通知。
optionExplanations_en: This mixes up two payment-flow entities with accounts: Transaction is not a customer account, and PaymentIntent is not a merchant account.
This assumes one-to-one: three failed card retries produce three attempt records, yet the merchant status page still shows a single result.
Separate the two: PaymentIntent owns the payment lifecycle end to end, and Transaction records each individual money-movement attempt.
As a persisted core record, PaymentIntent is written to the database — it is not just a one-off payload for webhooks.
scenario: 商户问：一次结账的卡支付失败重试三次才成功，为什么后台记录不止一条？
scenario_en: A merchant asks why one checkout has more than one record when the card failed three times before finally succeeding.

q: 补全 PaymentIntent 的常见生命周期：
text: PaymentIntent 通常从 {{created}} 开始，进入 {{processing}}，最终变为 {{succeeded}} 或 {{failed}}；更完整系统还会有 authorized/captured/canceled/refunded 等状态。
why: 支付处理是多阶段流程，状态机能把外部网络的异步结果和商户可见状态连接起来。
why_en: Payment processing is a multi-step workflow, so a state machine connects asynchronous network outcomes to merchant-visible status.
diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> created
  created --> processing
  processing --> succeeded
  processing --> failed
  succeeded --> [*]
  failed --> [*]

termDefinitions.meaning: 用状态和转移规则描述对象生命周期的模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A state machine models an object's lifecycle as a set of states and transitions.

scenario: 商户在结账页开始时想声明要收 2499 美分，币种 usd，并拿到后续支付会引用的 ID。
q: 应该使用哪个 API 语义？
options: GET /payment-intents/{id} 创建 PaymentIntent
DELETE /payment-intents/{id} 创建 PaymentIntent
POST /webhooks 直接扣款
POST /payment-intents 创建 PaymentIntent
why: 创建收款意图是生成新资源，POST /payment-intents 返回 paymentIntentId，后续 charge 和查询都围绕它进行。
why_en: Creating a payment intent is creating a new resource, so POST returns an identifier used by later charge and status calls.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是查询已存在支付状态，GET /payment-intents/{id} 才合适。
options_en: GET /payment-intents/{id} to create a PaymentIntent.
DELETE /payment-intents/{id} to create a PaymentIntent.
POST /webhooks to charge directly.
POST /payment-intents to create a PaymentIntent.
tradeoff: 创建新资源(POST) vs 查询已有状态(GET)
q_en: Which API semantics should be used here?
scenario_en: At checkout start, a merchant wants to declare a 2,499-cent USD charge and receive an ID that later payment calls will reference.
optionExplanations: GET 语义上只读取已有资源，不该拿它去创建新的 PaymentIntent。
DELETE 表示删除资源，语义正好和创建收款意图相反。
/webhooks 是事件通知入口，不是商户发起收款的地方。
声明要收一笔新钱本质是创建资源，服务端返回的 ID 会成为后续扣款、状态查询和通知的共同锚点。
optionExplanations_en: GET is meant to read an existing resource, not create a new PaymentIntent as a side effect.
DELETE means removing a resource, the opposite of creating a payment intent.
/webhooks is an event-notification endpoint, not where a merchant initiates a charge.
Declaring a new charge is creating a resource, and the ID returned becomes the shared anchor for later capture, status reads and notifications.

scenario: 商户需要知道支付何时成功，以便发货或开通数字服务；轮询可用但希望更实时且少请求。
q: 支付状态变更的行业常见推送方式是什么？
options: 商户注册 webhook，状态变化时收到 POST 事件
用 WebSocket 给客户浏览器持续推送最新的支付状态
运营每天人工导出并邮件发送一份 CSV 报表
让客户对着付款结果页面截图留证
why: webhook 是 server-to-server 通知，适合商户系统在支付成功/失败时触发业务流程。
why_en: Webhooks are server-to-server notifications that let merchant systems react to payment status changes.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是商户后台偶尔查看状态，GET 查询足够；如果是浏览器 UI 的实时交互，WebSocket/SSE 才更贴合。
options_en: The merchant registers a webhook and receives a POST on each status change.
Keep pushing the latest payment status to the customer's browser over WebSocket.
Ops manually exports and emails a CSV report every day.
Have the customer screenshot the payment result page as proof.
tradeoff: 系统间主动推送 vs 客户端实时连接

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务器在事件发生时主动向另一台服务器的 URL 发起 HTTP 请求通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A webhook is a server-to-server HTTP callback that fires when an event occurs.

q_en: What is the common industry pattern for pushing payment status changes?
scenario_en: A merchant needs to know when a payment succeeds so it can ship goods or unlock a digital service; polling works but should be more realtime and less chatty.
optionExplanations: 商户注册回调地址后，平台在状态变化时主动 POST 过去，这是行业标准的系统间通知方式。
WebSocket 是面向浏览器客户端的实时连接，不是给商户后端做系统对系统通知用的。
人工每天导出 CSV 邮件延迟以天计，完全跟不上商户要及时发货或开通服务的需求。
截图是非结构化证据，没法被商户系统自动解析或触发履约动作。
optionExplanations_en: Once the merchant registers a callback URL the platform POSTs to it on every status change — the industry-standard system-to-system notification.
WebSocket is a realtime channel aimed at browser clients, not a system-to-system notification for merchant backends.
A daily manual CSV export lags by a day, far too slow for a merchant that needs to ship or unlock service promptly.
A screenshot is unstructured evidence that no merchant system can parse or use to trigger fulfillment.

scenario: 所有商户请求进入系统时都需要认证、限流，并路由到 PaymentIntent 或 Transaction 服务。
q: 入口层应承担什么职责？
options: 数据库直接暴露到公网
API Gateway 做认证、限流和路由
Kafka broker 直接解析信用卡表单
Webhook Service 处理所有同步 API
why: API Gateway 是商户 API 的边界，负责横切能力并把业务请求交给内部服务。
why_en: The API gateway is the merchant-facing boundary for authentication, rate limiting, and routing to internal services.
whenOtherWins: 内部服务之间的高吞吐异步事件流应走 Kafka，不应把 API Gateway 当事件日志。
options_en: Expose the database directly to the public internet.
An API gateway handles authentication, rate limiting, and routing.
Have the Kafka broker parse credit-card forms directly.
Have the Webhook Service handle every synchronous API call.
tradeoff: 统一边界能力 vs 服务各自处理横切逻辑

termDefinitions.meaning: 分布式事件流平台，用来异步、按顺序传递事件消息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kafka is a distributed event-streaming platform used to pass events asynchronously and in order.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务器在事件发生时主动向另一台服务器的 URL 发起 HTTP 请求通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A webhook is a server-to-server HTTP callback that fires when an event occurs.

q_en: What responsibility should the entry layer own?
scenario_en: Every merchant request entering the system needs authentication, rate limiting, and routing to PaymentIntent or Transaction services.
optionExplanations: 数据库直接暴露公网既没有认证也没有限流，攻击面完全失控。
认证、限流、路由这些横切职责天然属于入口层，API Gateway 正是商户 API 的边界。
Kafka 是异步事件流组件，不该承担解析信用卡表单这种同步业务逻辑。
Webhook Service 是向外投递通知的消费者，不是承接商户同步 API 请求的入口。
optionExplanations_en: Exposing the database straight to the public internet has no auth or rate limiting, leaving the attack surface wide open.
Authentication, rate limiting, and routing are cross-cutting entry-layer jobs, and the API gateway is exactly that boundary for merchant traffic.
Kafka is an asynchronous event-streaming component, not the place to parse a credit-card form's synchronous logic.
The Webhook Service delivers outbound notifications; it isn't the entry point for a merchant's synchronous API calls.

scenario: 商户 API key 若泄露，攻击者可能重放旧请求；支付系统需要证明请求未被篡改且在有效时间窗内。
q: 比静态 API key 更安全的认证方案是什么？
options: 只把 API key 放在 URL 的 query 参数里明文传输
每次请求都强制客户输入图形验证码
签名认证：对请求内容、时间戳和 nonce 做 HMAC
只把商户 ID 写进请求 body，不做任何签名
why: HMAC 签名同时验证来源和内容完整性，timestamp 与 nonce 限制重放窗口。
why_en: HMAC request signing proves authenticity and integrity while timestamp and nonce checks limit replay attacks.
whenOtherWins: 低风险内部工具可能静态 API key 就够；公开金融 API 不应只靠长期 bearer token。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  R[Request]
  S[Server secret]
  H[Recompute HMAC]
  N[Check nonce time]
  A[Accept or reject]
  R --> H
  S --> H
  H --> N --> A
options_en: Send the API key in clear text as a URL query parameter only.
Force the customer to solve a CAPTCHA on every request.
Signed auth: HMAC over the request body, timestamp and nonce.
Just put the merchant ID in the body with no signature at all.
tradeoff: 签名防篡改防重放 vs 静态凭证仅声明身份

termDefinitions.meaning: 用密钥对消息计算的哈希签名，用来验证消息来源和是否被篡改。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HMAC is a keyed hash used to verify a message's origin and integrity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每次请求唯一的随机值，用来防止请求被重放。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A nonce is a unique per-request value used to prevent replay attacks.

q_en: What authentication scheme is safer than a static API key?
scenario_en: If a merchant API key leaks, an attacker may replay old requests; the payment system must prove the request was not tampered with and is inside a valid time window.
optionExplanations: 把 key 放进 URL query 很容易被日志、代理和浏览器历史记下来，反而扩大泄露面。
验证码是给人看的交互，服务器对服务器的自动化请求根本没法解验证码。
用 secret 对请求内容、时间戳和 nonce 做 HMAC，既能验证来源又能挡重放，比静态 key 强得多。
只写商户 ID 不签名，任何人都能伪造身份提交请求。
optionExplanations_en: Putting the key in a URL query string gets it logged by servers, proxies, and browser history, widening the leak surface.
CAPTCHAs are for humans; a server-to-server automated request has no way to solve one.
HMAC-signing the body, timestamp, and nonce with a secret proves both origin and freshness, well beyond what a static key offers.
Putting only the merchant ID in the body with no signature lets anyone forge the identity and submit requests.

scenario: API Gateway 收到带 API key、timestamp、nonce 和签名的商户请求，需要判断如何验证。
q: 验证流程最关键的一步是哪一个？
options: 只检查 Authorization header 字段是否存在就放行
把 nonce 存进客户端 localStorage 里做去重
让数据库层的唯一约束自动接受签名字段
用商户 secret 重算 HMAC 并检查 timestamp/nonce
why: 服务端必须用已知 secret 重算签名并做时间窗、nonce 去重；仅有 header 并不能防伪造或重放。
why_en: The gateway must recompute the HMAC with the merchant secret and validate timestamp and nonce to prevent tampering and replay.
whenOtherWins: 如果服务间走 mTLS 且不暴露给商户，签名可能不是必需，但公网商户 API 需要它。
codeSample:
Authorization: Bearer pk_live_...
X-Request-Timestamp: 2023-10-15T14:22:31Z
X-Request-Nonce: a1b2c3d4
X-Signature: sha256=<hmac(method,path,body,timestamp,nonce)>
options_en: Just check that the Authorization header field is present and let the request through.
Store the nonce in the client's localStorage to deduplicate.
Let a database-level unique constraint auto-accept the signature field.
Recompute the HMAC with the merchant secret and validate the timestamp and nonce.
tradeoff: 服务端重算校验 vs 仅检查请求是否携带签名
q_en: What is the most important step in the request verification flow?
scenario_en: The API Gateway receives a merchant request with an API key, timestamp, nonce, and signature, and must decide how to verify it.
optionExplanations: 字段存在只说明请求带了个值，网关没重算就放行，伪造请求照样能过。
去重表必须由服务端持有，放在客户端 localStorage 等于让攻击者自己管防重放。
唯一约束只保证列不重复，它不会做密码学校验，签名必须在网关主动重算。
用商户 secret 重算 HMAC 并核对 timestamp/nonce，才能同时防住伪造和重放。
optionExplanations_en: A present field only proves something was sent; if the gateway lets it through without recomputing, a forged request passes just as easily.
The dedup store must live server-side; putting it in the client's localStorage lets the attacker manage replay protection.
A unique constraint only stops duplicate column values; it performs no cryptographic check, so the signature must be recomputed at the gateway.
Recomputing the HMAC with the merchant's secret and checking the timestamp and nonce together blocks both forgery and replay.

q: 只使用长期静态 API key（无到期时间的密钥）的主要安全风险是什么？
options: 泄露后可长期被重放使用
无法支持 HTTPS
数据库不能索引 key
商户无法创建 PaymentIntent
why: 静态凭证每次请求都携带，一旦在代码仓库、配置或网络边界泄露，就可能被攻击者长期滥用。
why_en: A leaked static API key can be replayed indefinitely because it is a long-lived bearer credential.
options_en: A leaked key can be replayed indefinitely.
It cannot support HTTPS.
The database cannot index the key.
Merchants cannot create a PaymentIntent.
q_en: What is the main security risk of using only long-lived static API keys?
optionExplanations: 静态 key 没有失效或签名校验，一旦泄露就能被攻击者反复重放使用。
认证方式和是否支持 HTTPS 传输是两码事，API key 本身不影响 HTTPS。
key 只是普通字符串字段，数据库完全可以正常给它建索引。
静态 key 本身就能被用来创建请求，问题出在安全性而不是这项功能能不能用。
optionExplanations_en: A static key has no lapse or signature check, so once leaked it can be replayed by an attacker indefinitely.
The auth scheme and HTTPS support are unrelated; using an API key doesn't stop HTTPS from working.
The key is just a plain string column, and databases index those without any trouble.
A static key can still be used to create requests just fine; the issue is its security, not whether the feature works.
scenario: 支付网关签发给商户的 key 存在商户 CI 配置里、从不轮换，请求走公网。
scenario_en: The gateway issues each merchant a key that sits in their CI config, is never rotated, and travels over the public internet.

scenario: 客户在商户网页输入卡号，目标是尽量让敏感卡数据不要经过商户服务器，降低商户 PCI 负担和泄露风险。
q: 更合理的卡数据收集方式是什么？
options: 商户服务器先收集卡号再转发给支付系统处理
支付系统 SDK 在商户页面嵌入来自支付域名的安全 iframe
打电话让客户口头告知客服卡号
直接把卡号写进 URL 的 query string 里
why: 支付域名的 iframe 形成浏览器同源边界，商户页面代码无法直接读取卡号，减少敏感数据触达面。
why_en: A payment-domain iframe uses the browser same-origin boundary to keep raw card data away from merchant servers and page scripts.
whenOtherWins: 若商户是完全 PCI 合规的大型处理方，直接收卡也可能可行，但平台型支付系统通常要替商户降合规负担。
options_en: The merchant server collects the card number first, then forwards it for processing.
The payment SDK embeds a secure iframe from the payment domain on the merchant page.
Have the customer read the card number aloud to support over the phone.
Put the card number directly in the URL query string.
tradeoff: 同源隔离降低商户合规负担 vs 商户直收更简单但风险更高

termDefinitions.meaning: 网页里嵌入的独立文档窗口，受浏览器同源策略保护。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An iframe is an embedded document in a page that is isolated by the browser's same-origin policy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 支付卡行业制定的数据安全标准，规定如何处理持卡人数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PCI DSS is the payment card industry's data security standard for handling cardholder data.

q_en: What is the better way to collect card data?
scenario_en: A customer enters a card number on a merchant web page; the goal is to keep sensitive card data away from merchant servers and reduce PCI scope and breach risk.
optionExplanations: 卡号一旦落到商户服务器，商户系统就已经进入 PCI 合规范围，白白扩大了合规和泄露责任。
支付域名的 iframe 靠浏览器同源策略把商户页面代码和卡号输入框隔开，商户代码根本读不到卡号。
电话口述卡号既没有加密也没法审计，客服渠道完全不适合传递敏感支付数据。
卡号写进 URL 会被服务器日志、代理和浏览器历史悄悄记录下来，暴露面比表单提交大得多。
optionExplanations_en: Once the card number lands on the merchant server, the merchant's systems fall inside PCI scope, adding compliance burden and breach liability for nothing.
A payment-domain iframe uses the browser's same-origin boundary to keep merchant page code away from the card field entirely.
Reading a card number aloud over the phone has no encryption or audit trail — a support channel is the wrong place for sensitive payment data.
Putting the card number in a URL gets it quietly logged by servers, proxies, and browser history — far more exposure than a form post.

scenario: 仅靠 iframe 和 HTTPS 仍担心页面或传输层某处被攻破，希望卡号离开用户设备前就不可读。
q: 防御纵深的下一层是什么？
options: 把卡号简单做 base64 编码后再发送
让商户在自己日志系统里做脱敏处理即可
SDK 用平台公钥端上加密卡号，私钥存 HSM
把 CVC 安全码单独用邮件发送给客服
why: 客户端加密让卡数据在离开设备前就变成密文，HSM 保护私钥，HTTPS 只作为额外传输保护。
why_en: Client-side encryption with a payment public key makes card data ciphertext before it leaves the device, with private keys protected in HSMs.
whenOtherWins: 低风险非支付表单通常 HTTPS 足够；真实卡数据需要更强防御纵深。
options_en: Base64-encode the card number before sending.
Just have the merchant redact card numbers in its own logging system.
The SDK encrypts the card on the client with the platform's public key; the private key lives in an HSM.
Email the CVC security code separately to support.
tradeoff: 端上加密+HSM解密 vs 仅靠传输层(HTTPS)保护

termDefinitions.meaning: 专用硬件安全模块，用来安全存储密钥并执行加解密运算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An HSM is dedicated hardware that securely stores keys and performs encryption or decryption.

q_en: What is the next layer of defense-in-depth?
scenario_en: Even with an iframe and HTTPS, the team wants card numbers to be unreadable before leaving the user device.
optionExplanations: base64 只是编码格式，任何人拿到密文都能直接解码还原，不提供任何保密性。
脱敏只清理了商户自己的日志，卡号本身在传输和处理过程中仍然是明文。
SDK 用平台公钥在客户端把卡号加密成密文，只有 HSM 里的私钥能解开，卡数据从离开设备起就没有明文形态。
CVC 是不该被记录或转发的一次性安全码，用邮件传递既不加密也违反基本处理规则。
optionExplanations_en: Base64 is just an encoding, not encryption — anyone can decode it back to the original with no effort.
Redacting only cleans up the merchant's own logs; the card number itself is still plaintext everywhere else in the flow.
The SDK encrypts the card client-side with the platform's public key, so only the private key inside the HSM can decrypt it — plaintext never leaves the device.
The CVC is a one-time security code that should never be stored or forwarded; emailing it is both unencrypted and against basic handling rules.

scenario: 商户网页要收信用卡信息，但原始卡号最好不要被商户服务器或商户页面脚本直接接触。
q: 支付表单的安全分层通常包括哪些？（多选）
options: 支付域名 iframe，受浏览器同源策略隔离
客户端 public-key 加密
把原始卡号写到商户应用日志
HTTPS 传输保护
why: 三层各挡一类风险：iframe 让商户脚本读不到卡号，public-key 加密让离开设备的是密文，HTTPS 防网络窃听。日志原始卡号是反模式。
why_en: The layers defend different surfaces: the iframe blocks merchant scripts, public-key encryption makes card data ciphertext before transit, and HTTPS protects the connection.
options_en: A payment-domain iframe isolated by the browser's same-origin policy.
Client-side public-key encryption.
Log raw card numbers in the merchant application.
HTTPS transport protection.

termDefinitions.meaning: iframe：网页里嵌入的另一个网页窗口；这里由支付平台域名提供卡号输入框。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An iframe is an embedded page inside another page; here it hosts the card field from the payment domain.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同源策略：浏览器限制不同协议、域名或端口的页面互相读取数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The same-origin policy prevents pages from different schemes, hosts, or ports from reading each other's data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 公钥加密：公钥可公开给浏览器加密，只有对应私钥能解密。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Public-key encryption lets the browser encrypt with a public key while only the matching private key can decrypt.

termDefinitions.meaning: HTTPS：用 TLS 加密浏览器和服务器之间的网络传输。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HTTPS uses TLS to encrypt network traffic between the browser and the server.

termDefinitions.fullName: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard
termDefinitions.meaning: PCI DSS：处理银行卡数据时需要遵守的支付行业安全标准。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PCI DSS is the payment industry security standard for handling cardholder data.

q_en: Which layers usually belong in secure payment-form handling? (Select all that apply)
scenario_en: A merchant page needs to collect credit-card information, but raw card numbers should not be directly exposed to merchant servers or merchant page scripts.
optionExplanations: 支付域名 iframe 让卡号输入框脱离商户页面的同源范围，商户 JS 读不到里面的值。
客户端 public-key 加密让卡号在离开用户设备前就已经是密文。
把原始卡号写进商户应用日志是反模式——日志常被搜索、备份、转储，等于新开一个泄露渠道。
HTTPS 用 TLS 加密浏览器到服务端这一段连接，挡住网络中间人窃听。
optionExplanations_en: A payment-domain iframe puts the card field outside the merchant page's origin, so merchant JavaScript can't read what's inside.
Client-side public-key encryption turns the card number into ciphertext before it ever leaves the user's device.
Logging raw card numbers in the merchant app is an anti-pattern — logs get searched, backed up, and exported, opening a whole new leak path.
HTTPS encrypts the browser-to-server leg with TLS, blocking a network man-in-the-middle from reading traffic.

scenario: 系统需要创建交易记录、调用 Visa/Mastercard/银行网络，并接收授权、结算、拒付等外部状态变化。
q: 哪个服务应拥有这段职责？
options: 静态 CDN
Webhook Delivery Service
商户浏览器
Transaction Service
why: Transaction Service 负责内部交易状态和外部支付网络交互，减少无意义网络跳转并集中 PCI 控制面。
why_en: The Transaction Service owns transaction state and payment-network interaction, centralizing the PCI-sensitive processing path.
whenOtherWins: 纯状态查询可由 PaymentIntent Service 服务；对外商户通知才由 Webhook Service 处理。
options_en: A static CDN.
The Webhook Delivery Service.
The merchant's browser.
The Transaction Service.
tradeoff: 集中 PCI 控制面 vs 拆成多个服务增加网络跳
q_en: Which service should own this responsibility?
scenario_en: The system must create transaction records, call Visa/Mastercard or bank networks, and receive authorization, settlement, and dispute status changes.
optionExplanations: CDN 只做静态内容缓存分发，接触不到支付网络交互这类业务逻辑。
Webhook Delivery Service 是把结果通知商户的下游消费者，不直接连 Visa/Mastercard。
浏览器是客户端环境，不该持有调用支付网络所需的 PCI 敏感凭证。
建单、调 Visa/银行、收授权与结算回调放在一个服务里，少一次跨服务跳转，敏感卡数据也只需在一处加固。
optionExplanations_en: A CDN only caches and serves static content; it never touches business logic like talking to a payment network.
The Webhook Delivery Service notifies merchants downstream; it doesn't call Visa or Mastercard directly.
The browser is client-side and shouldn't hold the PCI-sensitive credentials needed to call a payment network.
Creating records, calling Visa or the bank, and receiving authorization and settlement callbacks in one service removes a hop and confines the sensitive card path to one place.

q: 补全支付网络的真实交互特征：
text: 支付网络往往不是普通公网 REST API，而是经由专线/VPN、mTLS、HSM 和专有协议（如 {{ISO 8583}}）接入，并可能异步返回后续状态。
why: 这解释了为什么支付处理要围绕异步、重试、对账和合规来设计，而不是当作普通内部服务调用。
why_en: Payment networks behave like asynchronous regulated external systems rather than simple internal REST services.

termDefinitions.meaning: 银行卡支付行业常用的报文格式标准，用于授权和清算消息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ISO 8583 is a common messaging standard used for card-payment authorization and settlement.

termDefinitions.meaning: 双向 TLS，通信双方都要出示证书互相验证身份。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: mTLS is mutual TLS, where both sides present certificates to verify each other's identity.

q: 把支付网络超时直接当成失败，最危险的后果是什么？
options: 银行已扣款成功，商户却看到失败并诱导重试，造成重扣
API Gateway 会永久失去对商户请求的限流能力
Kafka topic 的 partition 数会被自动改成 0
iframe 无法渲染
why: 超时只代表我们没收到结果，不代表外部网络没处理；贸然标记失败会制造双扣或履约错配。
why_en: A timeout means the outcome is unknown, not failed, so treating it as failure can cause duplicate charges or fulfillment mismatches.
options_en: The bank already charged the customer while the merchant sees failure and prompts a retry, double-charging.
The API gateway permanently loses its ability to rate-limit merchant requests.
The Kafka topic's partition count is automatically reset to zero.
The iframe fails to render.
q_en: What is the most dangerous consequence of treating a payment-network timeout as failure?
optionExplanations: 银行侧可能已经扣款成功，商户却拿到失败提示去引导重试，一来一回就多扣了一笔。
限流是网关自己的独立能力，跟一次超时被判成什么结果没有关系。
partition 数由 topic 配置决定，不会因为超时判定策略而变化。
iframe 渲染是前端展示问题，跟支付网络超时的一致性风险完全是两件事。
optionExplanations_en: The bank may have completed the charge while the merchant, told it failed, prompts a retry — and that round trip is exactly how a second charge happens.
Rate limiting is a standalone gateway capability, unrelated to how one timeout gets classified.
Partition count comes from topic configuration; a timeout-classification policy never changes it.
iframe rendering is a frontend display concern, unrelated to the consistency risk of a payment-network timeout.
scenario: 商户提交 charge 后支付网络 5 秒没回包，我们要决定这笔 transaction 落成什么状态。
scenario_en: After a charge is submitted the payment network doesn't answer within five seconds, and we must decide what state that transaction lands in.

scenario: 支付网络 30 秒无响应，但外部银行可能已经批准并扣款；商户和客户需要避免重复扣款。
q: 内部状态最应该如何表达？
options: 立即标记为 failed 并通知商户
pending_verification 待验证状态
直接标记为 succeeded 放行履约
直接把这条记录 deleted 删除
why: 超时是未知态，应该进入待验证状态并由后台对账查询网络结果，而不是猜成功或失败。
why_en: A network timeout is an unknown outcome, so the system should mark it pending verification and reconcile later.
whenOtherWins: 如果外部系统明确返回 decline，才可以标 failed；如果明确授权成功，才可以推进成功路径。
options_en: Mark it failed immediately and notify the merchant.
Mark it pending_verification.
Mark it succeeded and let fulfillment proceed.
Delete the record outright.
tradeoff: 承认未知、留给对账 vs 立即猜测成功或失败
q_en: How should the internal state represent this outcome?
scenario_en: The payment network has not responded for 30 seconds, but the external bank may already have approved and charged; the merchant and customer must avoid duplicate charges.
optionExplanations: 银行侧可能其实已经批准扣款，这时候标 failed 会诱导商户或客户重复发起支付。
结果未知时应该老实进入 pending_verification，交给后台对账去查真实的网络结果，而不是猜。
银行也可能确实拒绝了这笔交易，直接标 succeeded 会让商户在没收到钱的情况下就放行履约。
删除这条记录会连带丢掉后续对账和审计需要的全部线索。
optionExplanations_en: The bank side may have already approved the charge, so marking it failed here can prompt a duplicate attempt.
When the outcome is unknown, the honest move is pending_verification, letting reconciliation look up the real network result instead of guessing.
The bank may equally well have declined the charge, so marking it succeeded can let fulfillment proceed with no money actually collected.
Deleting the record wipes out the trail that reconciliation and audit would need later.

scenario: 商户在网络抖动后用同一个业务请求重试创建/支付，系统必须返回原记录而不是再次扣款。
q: 哪种数据库约束最直接支持商户重试幂等？
options: INDEX (merchant_id, created_at)
CHECK (currency IN ('usd','eur','jpy'))
UNIQUE (merchant_id, idempotency_key)
FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES merchants
why: 同一商户同一 idempotency key 只能创建一条记录，重试时读取已有 PaymentIntent/Transaction。
why_en: A unique constraint on merchant and idempotency key ensures retries return the existing record instead of creating another charge.
whenOtherWins: 普通查询优化用索引；这里要防重复副作用，唯一约束才是关键。
codeSample:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uniq_payment_idempotency
ON payment_requests (merchant_id, idempotency_key);
options_en: INDEX (merchant_id, created_at).
CHECK (currency IN ('usd','eur','jpy')).
UNIQUE (merchant_id, idempotency_key).
FOREIGN KEY (merchant_id) REFERENCES merchants.
tradeoff: 数据库唯一约束防重复 vs 应用层自行判断去重

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端提供的请求去重键，同一个 key 的重复请求只会生效一次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An idempotency key is a client-supplied token that ensures a repeated request only takes effect once.

q_en: Which database constraint most directly supports idempotent merchant retries?
scenario_en: A merchant retries the same business request after a network glitch; the system must return the original record instead of charging again.
optionExplanations: 普通索引只能加速按商户和时间的查询，挡不住同一个请求被插成两条记录。
CHECK 只校验币种取值合不合法，跟重试要不要去重没有关系。
UNIQUE(merchant_id, idempotency_key) 让同一商户同一个 key 只能存在一条记录，重试直接撞约束返回原记录。
外键只保证 merchant_id 确实存在，同一笔请求照样能被处理两次。
optionExplanations_en: A plain index only speeds up lookups by merchant and time; it cannot stop one request from being inserted twice.
CHECK only validates that the currency value is legal, which has nothing to do with deduplicating retries.
UNIQUE(merchant_id, idempotency_key) allows only one row per merchant per key, so a retry hits the constraint and returns the original record.
A foreign key only guarantees the merchant_id exists; the same request can still be processed twice.

q: 处理一次外部支付网络调用的可靠顺序是什么？
steps: 根据结果更新 attempt 为 succeeded/failed/timeout
先写 attempt 记录，包含 network、referenceId 和意图
timeout 事件由 Reconciliation Service 查询外部网络
再调用外部支付网络
why: 先记录意图再执行外部副作用，才能在超时或崩溃后知道自己试图做过什么并继续对账。
why_en: Recording the attempt before the external side effect preserves the intent needed for retries and reconciliation.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  I[Create idempotent transaction]
  P[Set processing]
  N[Call payment network]
  U[Record outcome or unknown]
  I --> P --> N --> U

termDefinitions.meaning: 用外部权威记录核对并修正内部状态的过程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Reconciliation is the process of matching internal records against an external authoritative source.

scenario: 外部支付网络可能实时查询，也会定期提供批量结算/对账文件；内部 timeout 状态必须最终收敛。
q: 应该引入哪个组件？
options: 只部署一个 Image CDN 加速静态图片
前端加一个客户端倒计时器控件
新增一个游戏排行榜服务
Reconciliation Service 对账服务
why: 对账服务把内部 attempt 与外部权威记录关联，修正 timeout、丢响应和结算状态差异。
why_en: A reconciliation service correlates internal attempts with external authoritative records to resolve unknown or drifted payment states.
whenOtherWins: 如果外部系统完全同步且强可靠，简单请求/响应足够；真实支付网络通常不是这种形态。
options_en: Just deploy an image CDN to speed up static images.
Add a client-side countdown timer widget.
Add a game leaderboard service.
A Reconciliation Service.
tradeoff: 主动对账收敛不确定态 vs 被动等待客户端反馈
q_en: Which component should be introduced?
scenario_en: The external payment network may support realtime queries and also deliver batch settlement or reconciliation files; internal timeout states must eventually converge.
optionExplanations: CDN 只负责加速静态图片分发，参与不了支付状态的判定。
前端倒计时器只是 UI 展示效果，查不到银行侧的真实处理结果。
游戏排行榜服务和支付状态的收敛没有任何关系。
对账服务把内部 pending 记录和外部实时查询、批量结算文件关联起来，把未知状态收敛成确定结果。
optionExplanations_en: An image CDN only speeds up static assets; it plays no role in deciding payment state.
A client-side countdown is just a UI effect; it can't look up the bank's actual processing result.
A game leaderboard service has nothing to do with resolving payment state.
A reconciliation service ties internal pending records to external realtime queries and batch settlement files, resolving unknown states into certainty.

q: 对账服务通常会使用哪些外部信号？（多选）
options: 按 network referenceId 做实时状态查询
支付网络定时交付的批量 reconciliation/settlement files
内部 CDC/Kafka timeout events
客户浏览器截图
why: 实时查询、批量文件和内部事件共同把未知状态推进到确定结果；截图不是可审计的权威来源。
why_en: Realtime status queries, batch settlement files, and internal timeout events together move uncertain payments toward authoritative outcomes.
options_en: Real-time status queries by network reference ID.
Batch reconciliation/settlement files delivered periodically by the payment network.
Internal CDC/Kafka timeout events.
Customer browser screenshots.
q_en: Which external signals does a reconciliation service usually use? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: 按 network referenceId 实时查询能直接问外部网络这笔交易现在是什么状态。
支付网络定期交付的批量结算文件是权威的、可审计的结果来源。
内部 CDC/Kafka 的 timeout 事件是触发对账流程该去查哪些记录的信号。
客户浏览器截图是非结构化证据，系统解析不了也没法作为审计依据。

Only update the payments.status field in place, leaving no trace.

q_en: What is the more robust audit architecture?
scenario_en: Years later, the payment system must still prove how a payment moved from creation through authorization, capture, and dispute, without relying on application code to hand-write every audit insert.
optionExplanations: CDC 从数据库提交日志层捕获变更，不依赖应用代码记得写审计，Kafka 和归档再把它变成可追加、多消费者能用的历史。
只做原地 UPDATE 会覆盖旧值，之前的状态变迁就再也证明不出来了。
接入层访问日志记录的是请求本身，不包含支付状态迁移的业务语义。
商户没有平台内部系统的写权限，没法记录一份真实完整的审计历史。
optionExplanations_en: CDC captures changes at the committed-log level without relying on application code to remember an audit insert, and Kafka plus archiving turn that into an append-only, multi-consumer history.
Updating status in place overwrites the old value, so the prior transition can never be proven again.
Access logs at the edge capture the request itself, not the business meaning of a payment status transition.
Merchants have no write access to the platform's internal systems, so they can't produce a real, complete audit history.

q: 只在关系库里原地 UPDATE payment status，为什么不满足支付审计？

会覆盖历史状态，难以证明完整事件序列
关系库的事务无法覆盖跨表的多行更新
UPDATE 之后无法再把当前状态返回给商户
why: 原地更新保留当前值但丢掉状态变迁证据，应用 bug 也可能静默破坏历史。
why_en: In-place updates preserve current state but erase the transition history needed for audits and dispute investigation.
options_en: SQL's DECIMAL type cannot store monetary amounts precisely.
It overwrites history, making it hard to prove the full sequence of events.
Relational transactions cannot span multi-row updates across tables.
After an UPDATE the current state can no longer be returned to the merchant.
q_en: Why is updating payment status in place in a relational database not enough for payment audit?
optionExplanations: DECIMAL 正是为精确金额设计的定点类型，会丢精度的是 FLOAT，跟留不留痕迹无关。
UPDATE 会覆盖旧值，之前每一次状态转移的证据就随之消失，事后没法证明完整的事件序列。
关系库的事务天然覆盖跨表多行更新，问题不出在事务能力上。
原地更新恰恰能正确返回当前状态，缺的是历史，不是读取能力。
optionExplanations_en: DECIMAL is the fixed-point type built for exact money — FLOAT is what loses precision — and neither affects whether history is kept.
UPDATE overwrites the old value, erasing evidence of every prior transition, so the full event sequence can no longer be proven.
Relational transactions cover multi-table, multi-row updates by design; transaction capability was never the gap.
In-place updates return current state just fine — what is missing is history, not read capability.
scenario: 合规要求能证明一笔支付从 pending 到 captured 的每一步和时间点，留存 7 年。
scenario_en: Compliance requires proving every step and timestamp of a payment from pending to captured, retained for seven years.

q: 应用代码手动写 audit table 的主要缺陷是什么？

审计表必须用 Redis 才能实现
开发者漏写 audit insert 会悄悄丢失历史
审计记录写入后不能再追加新行
why: 手动双写依赖每条代码路径都正确执行，且把高吞吐 OLTP 与多年审计查询耦合在同一库上。
why_en: Manual audit inserts depend on every application path doing the right thing and couple operational writes with long-term audit storage.
options_en: An audit table cannot support SELECT queries once built.
An audit table must be implemented with Redis.
If a developer forgets the audit insert, history silently disappears.
Audit records cannot be appended after being written.
q_en: What is the main flaw of manually writing an audit table in application code?
optionExplanations: 普通表建好之后完全支持 SELECT 查询，这不是它的问题所在。
审计表可以用任何关系库实现，没有必须绑定 Redis 这回事。
手动双写依赖每一条代码路径都记得插入审计行，哪一处漏写，那部分历史就悄悄消失了。
审计表设计上本来就是只追加插入，问题不在于能不能追加新行。
optionExplanations_en: A regular table supports SELECT queries just fine once built; that isn't where the risk lives.
An audit table can live in any relational database — there's no requirement to use Redis.
Manual dual-writes depend on every code path remembering the audit insert, and one missed spot makes that slice of history silently vanish.
An audit table is designed to be append-only by nature; the flaw isn't about whether new rows can be added.
scenario: 团队想在业务代码里每次改状态时顺手 INSERT 一条 audit 行，主库已扛 10k TPS 写入。
scenario_en: The team wants to hand-insert an audit row in application code on every state change, while the primary database already takes 10k writes per second.

q: CDC（变更数据捕获）审计架构的数据流正确顺序是什么？

Kafka 保存按 key 分区的追加事件流
CDC 从 WAL/oplog 捕获 committed changes
why: 业务库先提交当前状态，CDC 从日志捕获并写入事件流，下游消费者再按用途构建审计、对账和通知视图。
why_en: The operational database commits first, CDC captures the log, Kafka stores the event stream, and consumers build their specialized views.
diagram:
flowchart TD

options_en: A random UUID.

q_en: What is the best Kafka topic partition key here?
scenario_en: The payment event stream must handle about 10k TPS while preserving the order of state transitions for each PaymentIntent.
optionExplanations: 随机 UUID 能把负载打散，但同一个 PaymentIntent 的事件也会散落到不同分区，顺序就保不住了。
回调地址是商户配置的一个属性，不是决定事件该进哪个分区的维度。
事件载荷大小和顺序、路由都没有关系，用它分区没有意义。
用支付意图 ID 当 key，同一笔支付的事件哈希到同一分区排队，不同支付之间照样并行跑。
optionExplanations_en: A random UUID spreads load evenly, but it also scatters one PaymentIntent's events across partitions, breaking their order.
The callback URL is a merchant config attribute, not a dimension that should decide which partition an event lands in.
Payload size has nothing to do with ordering or routing, so keying on it doesn't accomplish anything.
Keying on the payment intent ID hashes one payment’s events into a single partition queue while different payments still run in parallel.

q: 这组数字最支持哪个分区设计判断？
options: 多分区（3-5 个）按 payment_intent_id 分区
只用 1 个 partition，让所有事件严格全局有序
分区数量对吞吐没有影响，用多少都一样
为了吞吐应该按随机 UUID 分区
why: 单 partition 先按 10k-50k msg/s 粗估；10k TPS 已踩到低端且还要留 2-5x 余量。多分区按 payment_intent_id 分摊吞吐，同时保留单个意图内顺序。
why_en: Use 10k-50k msg/s as a rough single-partition anchor. A 10k TPS peak is already near the low end and still needs 2-5x headroom, so multiple partitions keyed by payment_intent_id add throughput while preserving per-payment ordering.
scenario: Kafka 单个 partition 先按 10k-50k msg/s 粗估；系统峰值约 10k TPS，仍需留 2-5x 余量，且要保证同一 PaymentIntent 内事件有序。
options_en: Multiple partitions (about 3-5) keyed by payment_intent_id.
Use just 1 partition so every event is strictly globally ordered.
Partition count has no effect on throughput; any number works.
Partition by random UUID to maximize throughput.

scenario_en: Use roughly 10k-50k messages per second as a Kafka single-partition anchor; the system peaks around 10k TPS, still needs 2-5x headroom, and must keep events ordered within a PaymentIntent.
optionExplanations: 开 3-5 个分区后每个分区只摊到 2-3k 条/秒，离单分区天花板还有 3 倍以上余量。

Partition count is exactly what bounds parallel throughput; claiming it has no effect is simply wrong.
Random-UUID partitioning does raise throughput, but it scrambles the order of events within a single payment.

q: 支付事件流常用 Kafka replication factor=3（副本数）的主要目的是什么？

跨 broker 保留副本，容忍单点故障
让 partition key 失效
以为副本能替代数据库事务保证
why: 支付事件不能轻易丢失，副本分散在多个 broker/可用区能承受单点 broker 故障。
why_en: A replication factor of three keeps copies across brokers or zones so a broker failure does not lose payment events.
options_en: Assume replica count means each message is processed three times, charging three times.
Keep copies across brokers so a single broker failure is tolerated.
Invalidate the partition key.
Assume replication can substitute for database transaction guarantees.
q_en: What is the main purpose of replication factor three for payment-event Kafka topics?
optionExplanations: 副本数是持久性配置，不会让同一条消息被消费和处理三次，更不会让客户被扣三次款。

分区键决定事件路由到哪个分区，副本数是另一个独立配置项，两者不冲突。
Kafka 复制解决的是消息持久性，替代不了数据库事务提供的原子性和一致性保证。
optionExplanations_en: Replica count is a durability setting; it doesn't make one message get processed three times, let alone charge a customer three times.
A replication factor of three spreads copies across brokers, so losing one broker doesn't lose the event.
The partition key decides which partition an event routes to; replica count is a separate setting that doesn't interfere with it.
Kafka replication buys durability; it can't substitute for the atomicity and consistency a database transaction provides.
scenario: 支付事件流是审计和对账的唯一来源，单台 broker 宕机时一条事件都不能丢。

q: CDC（变更数据捕获）系统本身故障时，主要风险和缓解是什么？

API key 全部失效；重启 Gateway 即可

All API keys become invalid; just restart the gateway.
Events stop reaching Kafka; mitigate with lag monitoring and log replay recovery.
The iframe becomes cross-origin; switch browsers.

CDC 是审计管道的一环，跟 API key 认证是两个完全独立的系统。
数据库写入照常提交，但没人把变更发布出去，需要 lag 监控发现问题，再靠日志回放补齐漏掉的事件。
CDC 故障发生在后端管道，跟浏览器里 iframe 的跨域问题完全不是一回事。

CDC is part of the audit pipeline, an entirely separate system from API-key authentication.
Database writes keep committing fine, but nothing publishes the changes, so lag monitoring has to catch it and log replay has to backfill the missed events.
CDC failure happens in the backend pipeline, unrelated to a browser iframe's cross-origin behavior.

Retrying with exponential backoff after a failure avoids piling more load onto a merchant system that's already struggling.
Signing the payload lets the merchant verify the event really came from the payment platform and wasn't tampered with.

q: 支付 webhook（服务器对服务器回调）和 WebSocket/SSE 的关键区别是什么？

optionExplanations: webhook 是商户服务器之间的调用，WebSocket/SSE 是面向客户端浏览器的实时连接，服务对象完全不同。
两者都是网络通信协议，跟浏览器把数据存在本地这件事完全不沾边。
webhook 打到的是商户服务器，客户手机在不在线根本不影响投递。
WebSocket 正是为持续双向实时通信设计的，事件推送恰恰是它的主场。
optionExplanations_en: A webhook is a server-to-server call to the merchant, while WebSocket/SSE are realtime connections aimed at the browser client — they serve different audiences.
Both are network transport mechanisms and have nothing to do with a browser storing data locally.
A webhook lands on the merchant's server; whether the customer's phone is online never affects delivery.
WebSocket exists precisely for persistent two-way realtime traffic; event push is its core use case.
scenario: 商户后端要在支付成功时自动发货，此时商户员工和客户浏览器都没有打开页面。
scenario_en: The merchant backend must ship the order the moment a payment succeeds, with no browser session open on either side.

q: 基于 CDC（变更数据捕获）的 webhook 投递链路正确顺序是什么？
steps: Webhook Service 过滤商户订阅事件并构造签名 payload
支付状态更新提交到 operational DB
失败时记录 attempt 并指数退避重试
CDC/Kafka 发布 payment status change event
商户 endpoint 返回 2xx 后标记投递成功
why: 状态提交产生事件，Webhook Service 负责筛选、签名和投递；成功停止，失败进入重试队列。
why_en: A committed status change becomes an event, the webhook service signs and sends it, then marks success or schedules retries.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  E[Payment event]
  K[Kafka]
  W[Webhook worker]
  M[Merchant endpoint]
  R[Retry queue]
  E --> K --> W --> M
  M -->|fail| R
  R --> W

termDefinitions.meaning: 每次重试等待时间成倍增加的重试策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Exponential backoff doubles the wait time between retries after each failure.

q_en: What is the correct order of a CDC-based webhook delivery flow?

scenario: 支付 operational DB 接近每秒 1 万写，商户数据天然隔离，绝大多数查询也按商户或支付 ID 定位。
q: 数据库扩展的合理分片键是什么？
options: 随机每行一个 shard
merchant_id
amountInCents
信用卡后四位
why: merchant_id 与租户边界和查询模式一致，能把商户流量分散到不同分片并保持相关数据局部性。
why_en: Sharding by merchant_id aligns with tenant boundaries and common query patterns while distributing write load.
whenOtherWins: 如果单个超大商户成为热点，可能需要再按 payment_id/time 做二级拆分或专属分片。
options_en: A random shard per row.
merchant_id.
amountInCents.
The last four digits of the card.
tradeoff: 按租户局部性分片 vs 按行随机打散负载
q_en: What is a reasonable sharding key for database scaling?
scenario_en: The payment operational database is near 10k writes per second; merchant data is naturally isolated, and most queries filter by merchant or payment ID.
optionExplanations: 随机分片打散了负载，却也把同一商户的数据撒到各个分片，查询要扇出到所有分片才能凑齐结果。
按 merchant_id 分片把租户边界和常见的按商户查询模式对齐，相关数据留在同一分片。
金额既不是数据归属维度，也不是查询过滤条件，用它分片没有意义。
卡片后四位是敏感数据，不该出现在分片键设计里。
optionExplanations_en: Random sharding spreads load, but it also scatters one merchant's rows across every shard, forcing queries to fan out everywhere to reassemble results.
Sharding by merchant_id aligns tenant boundaries with the common per-merchant query pattern, keeping related rows together.
The charge amount is neither a data-ownership dimension nor a common filter, so it makes a poor shard key.
The card's last four digits are sensitive data that shouldn't be part of a sharding-key design at all.

q: 这个增长量级最支持哪项存储策略？
options: 永久把所有历史数据留在主 OLTP 库里
数据增长可忽略，不用规划归档
老数据应定期归档到低成本对象存储，主库只留近期数据
改用无限内存缓存替代磁盘存储
why: 日增约 500GB、年增约 180TB 意味着主库不能无限增长；老交易应归档到 S3 一类冷存储，主库只保留近期热数据。
why_en: At roughly 500GB a day and 180TB a year, the operational database cannot keep growing forever, so older transactions should move to cheap cold storage.
scenario: 按 10k TPS、每行约 500 bytes 估算，支付数据每天新增约 500GB，一年约 180TB。
options_en: Keep all historical data in the primary OLTP database forever.
The growth is negligible, so no archiving plan is needed.
Archive old data to low-cost object storage periodically and keep only recent data in the primary database.
Switch to unlimited in-memory caching instead of disk storage.
q_en: What storage strategy is best supported by this growth estimate?
scenario_en: With 10k TPS and roughly 500 bytes per row, payment data grows by about 500GB per day and about 180TB per year.
optionExplanations: 三年数据全压在主 OLTP 库上就是 500TB 级单库，备份窗口、索引重建和扩容都会失控。
这个增长量级完全不是可忽略的，不做归档规划主库迟早扛不住。
按这个量级，老交易该定期挪到低成本对象存储，主库只留近期热数据，查询和容量压力才能分开。
无限内存缓存既没有这么大容量也不持久，支撑不了这个体量的长期存储。
optionExplanations_en: Three years of data in one OLTP database means a 500TB instance, and backup windows, index rebuilds and scaling all get out of hand.
This growth rate is far from negligible; skipping an archiving plan means the primary database eventually can't keep up.
At this scale, older transactions should move periodically to low-cost object storage while the primary keeps only recent hot data, separating query load from capacity pressure.
Unlimited in-memory caching has neither the capacity nor the durability to hold data at this volume long-term.

scenario: 支付 operational DB 中 3-6 个月前的交易很少被在线查询，但合规和审计要求长期可访问。
q: 合理的数据生命周期策略是什么？
options: 所有交易只保留最近 24 小时数据
把全部交易数据放进 Redis 内存
把超期的老交易直接随机删除
老交易归档到 S3 等冷存储，减轻主库压力
why: 冷热分层让近期在线查询保持快，长期合规数据进入低成本对象存储并可按需检索。
why_en: Tiering old transactions to object storage keeps operational queries fast while preserving long-term audit access.
whenOtherWins: 如果老数据仍被高频在线查询，应保留在 warm store 或专门分析库中，而不是直接归档到冷存储。
options_en: Keep only the last 24 hours of transaction data.
Put all transaction data in Redis memory.
Randomly delete old transactions once they age out.
Archive old transactions to cold storage such as S3, lightening the primary database.
tradeoff: 冷存储归档保留可查性 vs 主库无限增长
q_en: What is a reasonable data lifecycle strategy?
scenario_en: Transactions older than three to six months are rarely queried online in the operational database, but compliance and audits require long-term access.
optionExplanations: 合规审计常要求追溯数年，只留最近 24 小时数据远远不够。
Redis 是内存缓存，成本高又不持久，撑不起长期海量归档。
随机删除会永久破坏审计完整性，属于不可接受的数据丢失。
把老交易挪到 S3 这类冷存储，成本低还能长期保留，同时给主库减负。
optionExplanations_en: Compliance audits often need to trace back years, so keeping only the last 24 hours falls far short.
Redis is an in-memory cache — costly and not durable — a poor fit for long-term bulk archiving.
Randomly deleting aged-out records permanently breaks audit integrity — an unacceptable form of data loss.
Moving old transactions to cold storage like S3 keeps them cheaply and durably while taking the load off the primary database.

scenario: 商户频繁查询近期支付状态和报表，写路径仍由主库保证一致提交。
q: 读扩展可以优先采用什么？
options: 只读副本和对近期状态的缓存
把所有读取发到主库且不加索引
让 Kafka 直接响应 HTTP GET
把支付状态写进浏览器 cookie
why: 状态查询和报表读多时可用 read replicas 分担，热点近期状态可缓存；权威写仍在主库。
why_en: Read replicas and short-lived caches can offload status reads while the primary database remains the write authority.
whenOtherWins: 若读取必须刚写后立即强一致，应路由到主库或实现 read-your-writes，而不是盲读副本。
options_en: Read replicas and caching for recent status.
Send all reads to the primary with no indexes.
Have Kafka respond directly to HTTP GET requests.
Store payment status in a browser cookie.
tradeoff: 只读副本+缓存分担读 vs 全部读写压在主库
q_en: What should be the first read-scaling approach?
scenario_en: Merchants frequently query recent payment status and reports, while the write path still commits through the primary database.
optionExplanations: 只读副本分担查询、对近期状态加缓存，能让报表和状态查询不挤占写路径，写权威仍留在主库。
把所有读都压到主库还不加索引，写和读会一起挤占同一份资源。
Kafka 是异步事件日志，不是能同步响应 HTTP GET 的查询数据库。
cookie 存在客户端，没法作为服务端的权威状态来源。
optionExplanations_en: Read replicas plus caching for recent status offload queries without touching the write path, and the primary stays the write authority.
Sending every read to the primary with no indexes piles read and write load onto the same resource.
Kafka is an asynchronous event log, not a query database that can answer HTTP GET requests synchronously.
A cookie lives on the client and can't serve as the server's authoritative source of state.

scenario: PaymentIntent、Transaction、Webhook 等服务大多不持有本地会话状态，峰值流量会随假日销售突增。
scenario_en: PaymentIntent, Transaction, and Webhook services usually avoid local session state, while holiday sales can create sudden traffic spikes.
q: 应用服务层的默认扩展方式是什么？
q_en: What is the default scaling approach for the application service layer?
options: 所有流量固定一台主机
无状态服务加负载均衡水平扩展
每个商户手动启动一台笔记本
只靠数据库触发器处理 HTTP
why: 无状态实例不记本地会话，LB 可把请求打到任意健康实例；流量高了就加实例。有状态服务要先设计状态放哪。
why_en: Stateless services behind load balancers can scale horizontally to absorb bursty payment traffic.
whenOtherWins: 若服务必须保留本地状态，就要先外置到 DB/Redis，或用粘性会话/分片路由固定相关请求。
options_en: Pin all traffic to a single host.
Stateless services behind a load balancer, scaled horizontally.
Manually spin up a laptop per merchant.
Handle HTTP entirely with database triggers.
tradeoff: 无状态水平扩展 vs 单实例纵向堆资源

termDefinitions.meaning: 实例本地不保存必须延续到下一次请求的会话状态，请求打到任意健康实例都能处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A stateless service keeps no required session state on one instance, so any healthy instance can handle the next request.

termDefinitions.meaning: 实例本地保存会话或任务状态；扩容时要外置状态，或把相关请求固定路由到同一实例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A stateful service keeps session or task state locally, so scaling requires externalizing state or routing related requests to the same instance.

termDefinitions.meaning: Load Balancer（LB）：把请求分发给多台健康应用实例的入口组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A load balancer distributes incoming requests across healthy application instances.

optionExplanations: 所有流量固定一台主机，既扛不住突发流量也没有故障冗余。
无状态实例不记本地会话，负载均衡能把请求打到任意健康实例，流量高了直接加实例即可。
人工给每个商户开一台笔记本，既不能自动化也跟不上促销的突发速度。
数据库触发器运行在库内部，本来就不是设计来处理外部 HTTP 流量的。
optionExplanations_en: Pinning all traffic to one host can't absorb a burst and has no failover if that host dies.
Stateless instances keep no local session, so the load balancer can route to any healthy instance and scaling just means adding more.
Manually spinning up a laptop per merchant isn't automatable and can't keep pace with a promotion's burst.
Database triggers run inside the database engine; they were never meant to handle external HTTP traffic.

scenario: Transaction processing 需要判断是数据库写已经成功但 completed event 丢了，还是外部超时导致写根本没完成。
q: 文章提到的生产级强化模式是什么？
options: 只发一个 best-effort 日志
每次都让商户人工确认
两阶段事件：created + completed 分别记录
删除所有 pending transaction
why: created 事件记录开始处理，completed 事件记录数据库写完成；重试时可比较事件和 DB 状态，避免重复执行副作用。
why_en: A created event and a completed event let retries distinguish a missing completion event from a transaction that never committed.
whenOtherWins: 普通非金融 workflow 可能不需要两阶段事件；支付一致性风险使它值得讨论。
options_en: Emit just one best-effort log line.
Have the merchant manually confirm every time.
A two-phase model: separate created and completed events.
Delete every pending transaction.
tradeoff: 两阶段事件精确重试 vs 单阶段事件粗粒度重试
q_en: What production-grade hardening pattern is described here?
scenario_en: Transaction processing needs to tell whether the database write succeeded but the completed event was lost, or whether an external timeout meant the write never completed.
optionExplanations: 只发一条 best-effort 日志，分不清到底是数据库没写成功还是只是事件没发出来。
人工每次都确认完全跟不上高吞吐、异步处理的速度。
created 和 completed 分开记录，重试时能对比事件和数据库真实状态，精确判断该补发事件还是重跑整个流程。
删除所有 pending transaction 会连带丢掉正在真实处理中的交易记录。
optionExplanations_en: A single best-effort log line can't tell whether the database write failed or the completion event simply never went out.
Having a human confirm every transaction can't keep up with high-throughput asynchronous processing.
Recording created and completed as separate events lets a retry compare them against the real database state and decide precisely whether to resend the event or rerun the whole flow.
Deleting every pending transaction wipes out records for transactions that may still be genuinely in flight.

q: 两阶段 transaction event 中，如果关键事件发射失败，为什么要把 transaction 置为 locked/failed 等待修复？
options: 让客户在同一笔订单上多付一次款
减少 audit 表里累积的数据库行数
替代 webhook payload 上的 HMAC 签名校验
阻止后续更新在事件链不完整时继续推进
why: 事件链缺口会让下游审计、对账和 webhook 视图不一致，锁住可防止错误状态继续扩散。
why_en: Locking a transaction when event emission is incomplete prevents later updates from compounding inconsistent downstream views.
options_en: Make the customer pay a second time on the same order.
Reduce the number of rows accumulating in the audit table.
Replace HMAC signature verification on the webhook payload.
Block later updates from proceeding while the event chain is incomplete.
q_en: Why lock or fail a transaction when a critical two-phase event emission fails?
optionExplanations: 锁定只是把这笔交易冻住，不会再向银行发起任何扣款动作。
locked 只是一个状态标记，审计表照常追加，行数一行都不会少。
签名解决的是"这条通知是谁发的"，锁定解决的是"事件链完不完整"，两回事。
事件链有缺口时先锁住交易，能挡住下游审计、对账、webhook 在证据不全时继续基于错误状态推进。
optionExplanations_en: Locking merely freezes the transaction; it never sends another charge to the bank.
Locked is only a status flag; the audit table keeps appending and no rows go away.
Signatures answer "who sent this notification"; locking answers "is the event chain complete" — different concerns.
Locking a transaction when the event chain has a gap stops downstream audit, reconciliation, and webhooks from building further on an incomplete, possibly wrong state.
scenario: 两阶段事件里 transaction 已落库，但发往 Kafka 的关键事件发射失败，后续更新还在排队。
scenario_en: In a two-phase event flow the transaction is already persisted but its critical Kafka event failed to emit, while later updates are still queued.

q: 支付系统的 financial integrity 需要防哪些问题？（多选）
options: 重复扣款
把状态查询做成分页
银行成功但商户看到失败
审计事件丢失
why: 核心风险是钱和记录不一致：双扣、漏履约、丢审计都会造成金融和合规事故。
why_en: Financial integrity is about preventing duplicate charges, mismatched outcomes, and missing audit records.
options_en: Duplicate charges.
Paginating the status-query API.
The bank succeeds but the merchant sees failure.
Missing audit events.
q_en: What problems must payment-system financial integrity prevent? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: 同一笔款被扣了不止一次，是支付系统必须防住的核心风险。
状态查询要不要分页是接口设计细节，不是金融完整性问题。
银行那边成功了商户却看到失败，这种内外记录不一致会导致漏履约或客户投诉。
审计事件一旦丢失，后续举证和对账就失去了依据。
optionExplanations_en: The same charge being taken more than once is the core risk a payment system must prevent.
Whether the status API paginates is an interface design detail, not a financial-integrity concern.
When the bank succeeds but the merchant sees failure, that mismatch between internal and external records can cause missed fulfillment or complaints.
Once an audit event is lost, there's no basis left for proving what happened or reconciling it.
scenario: 支付平台上线前做风险评审，要挑出会直接造成资金损失或合规事故的失败模式。
scenario_en: Before launch we run a risk review on the payment platform and pick out the failure modes that directly cause money loss or a compliance incident.

scenario: 商户需要低延迟 API 当前状态，审计/对账/通知需要完整历史和异步消费。
q: 这两类需求应如何分层？
options: Operational DB 管当前态，事件流管历史
只用 Kafka 响应所有同步状态查询 API
只用 Redis 同时保存当前态和全部审计历史
把当前状态和完整历史都放在浏览器本地
why: OLTP 库优化同步读写，事件流优化追加历史和多消费者；分层后两边可独立扩展。
why_en: The operational database serves current synchronous state, while the event stream serves immutable history and asynchronous consumers.
whenOtherWins: 非常小的系统可以先合并在一个数据库中，但支付规模和审计要求会很快需要分离。
options_en: The operational DB owns current state; the event stream owns history.
Use Kafka alone to answer every synchronous status-query API call.
Use Redis alone to hold both current state and all audit history.
Keep both current state and the full history in browser local storage.
tradeoff: OLTP 服务当前态 vs 事件流服务历史与异步消费
q_en: How should these two requirement types be layered?
scenario_en: Merchants need a low-latency API for current status, while audit, reconciliation, and notification need full history and asynchronous consumption.
optionExplanations: Operational DB 服务同步读写的当前状态，事件流负责追加式历史，两边各自扩展互不拖累。
Kafka 是异步顺序消费的日志，拿它直接答复同步状态查询会把读延迟拖到不可控。
Redis 是内存态，既没有 7 年留存的耐久性，也不适合当唯一的审计存储。
浏览器既不可靠也不权威，当前状态和历史都不该由它保管。
optionExplanations_en: The operational DB serves synchronous reads/writes of current state while the event stream carries append-only history, letting each scale on its own.
Kafka is an asynchronously consumed log; answering synchronous status queries from it makes read latency unpredictable.
Redis is in-memory, lacking the durability for seven-year retention and unfit as the only audit store.
The browser is neither reliable nor authoritative, so neither current state nor history belongs there.

q: Audit Service 和 Analytics Consumer 消费同一 CDC（变更数据捕获）流时，目标差异是什么？
options: 二者都只负责发 webhook
Audit 存完整历史，Analytics 建业务聚合视图
Audit 删除历史，Analytics 处理认证
二者都替代 payment network
why: 同源事件可以被不同消费者按不同查询模式存储，审计重完整性，分析重聚合与查询便利。
why_en: Audit stores complete provable history, while analytics materializes business-friendly aggregate views from the same events.
options_en: Both are only responsible for sending webhooks.
Audit stores complete history; Analytics builds business aggregate views.
Audit deletes history; Analytics handles authentication.
Both replace the payment network.
tradeoff: 完整可证明历史 vs 面向查询的业务聚合视图
q_en: How do Audit Service and Analytics Consumer differ when consuming the same CDC stream?
optionExplanations: 发 webhook 通知是另一个独立消费者的职责，不是 Audit 或 Analytics 该做的事。
Audit 追求完整可举证的历史，Analytics 追求方便查询的业务聚合视图，同一条事件流被两种不同目标物化。
Audit 恰恰是只追加不删除的，Analytics 也不负责认证，这个说法把两者的职责都说反了。
两者都是内部事件消费者，都不直接对接银行网络，谈不上替代 payment network。
optionExplanations_en: Sending webhook notifications is a separate consumer's job, not something Audit or Analytics should own.
Audit aims for complete, provable history while Analytics aims for query-friendly business aggregates — the same event stream materialized toward two different goals.
Audit is append-only by design and never deletes, and Analytics doesn't handle authentication either — this gets both roles backwards.
Both are internal event consumers that never talk to the bank network directly, so neither replaces the payment network.
scenario: 同一条 CDC 事件同时喂两个消费者：一个要 7 年不可变留存，一个要跨商户聚合查询。
scenario_en: The same CDC event feeds two consumers: one needs seven years of immutable retention, the other needs aggregate queries across merchants.

q: 补全 webhook 基本模型：

q: Webhook（服务器间事件通知）投递失败时为什么不能紧密无限重试？
options: 会让签名更安全
会自动修复 PaymentIntent
会在商户故障时放大流量并拖垮对方系统
会减少 Kafka 分区需求
why: 商户 endpoint 可能正在故障，指数退避能避免雪上加霜，同时保留最终投递机会。
why_en: Exponential backoff avoids overwhelming a failing merchant endpoint while preserving eventual delivery attempts.
options_en: It makes signing more secure.
It automatically fixes the PaymentIntent.

It reduces how many Kafka partitions are needed.
q_en: Why should failed webhook delivery not retry tightly forever?

重试策略改变不了 PaymentIntent 本身的业务状态，不会自动修好任何东西。

投递重试策略跟 Kafka 该开几个分区是两个独立的配置决定。

A retry policy can't change the PaymentIntent's underlying business state; it fixes nothing automatically.
The merchant's endpoint may already be struggling, and retrying tightly with no backoff dumps even more traffic on it right when it's weakest.
How webhook delivery retries and how many Kafka partitions to run are two independent configuration decisions.

q: Webhook payload 应该包含什么安全机制？
options: 只靠请求来源的 IP 地址白名单做判断
把完整卡号和 CVV 明文写进 payload 传给商户
发短信让客户手动确认这笔通知是否真实
用共享 secret 给 payload 和时间戳签名

why_en: A webhook signature over payload and timestamp lets merchants verify origin and integrity and limit replay.
whenOtherWins: 私有专线内的固定集成可以叠加 IP allowlist，但不应替代 payload 签名。
options_en: Judge authenticity from a source-IP allowlist alone.
Put the full card number and CVV in clear text in the payload sent to the merchant.
Text the customer to manually confirm whether this notification is genuine.
Sign the payload and timestamp with a shared secret.
tradeoff: 共享密钥签名验证 vs 仅信任来源 IP
q_en: What security mechanism should a webhook payload include?
scenario_en: A merchant receives a payment.succeeded HTTP POST and needs to confirm it really came from the payment platform and was not tampered with.
optionExplanations: 来源 IP 容易被伪造，也会随商户上游代理变化，单靠白名单非常脆弱。
卡号和 CVV 是最高敏感级别数据，写进通知等于把商户拖进 PCI 范围。
webhook 是系统间调用，客户根本看不到这次请求，无从确认。
用共享 secret 给 payload 和时间戳签名，商户既能验证事件确实来自平台，又能靠时间戳挡住重放。
optionExplanations_en: Source IPs are easy to spoof and shift whenever an upstream proxy changes, so an allowlist alone is fragile.
Card number and CVV are the most sensitive data there is; putting them in a notification drags the merchant into PCI scope.
A webhook is a system-to-system call the customer never sees, so there is nothing for them to confirm.
Signing the payload and timestamp with a shared secret lets the merchant verify the event truly came from the platform and blocks replay via the timestamp.

直接查询 Visa 的内部授权数据库
重新提交一次 charge 把结果读回来

whenOtherWins: 需要自动触发履约时 webhook 更合适；需要历史审计时查 audit/event store。
options_en: GET /payment-intents/{id}.
Wait for the merchant webhook callback before the status can be seen.
Query Visa's internal authorization database directly.
Resubmit the charge to read the result back.
tradeoff: 按需 GET 查询 vs 被动等待 webhook 推送
q_en: What is the simplest way to read current payment status?
scenario_en: A merchant dashboard only occasionally checks the current status of one PaymentIntent and does not need second-level business triggers.
optionExplanations: 偶尔查看当前状态就是标准的读路径，GET /payment-intents/{id} 直接从主库返回结果就够了。
偶尔看一眼状态还要等推送，是给读路径加了没必要的时序耦合。
银行的授权库对外部商户完全不可见，压根没有这条访问路径。
重新提交 charge 会真的再动一次钱，那是写路径不是查询。
optionExplanations_en: Occasionally checking current status is a plain read path — GET /payment-intents/{id} returning straight from the primary database is enough.
Waiting on a push just to glance at status adds timing coupling the read path does not need.
The bank's authorization database is invisible to outside merchants; that access path simply does not exist.
Resubmitting a charge actually moves money again — that is a write path, not a query.

webhook 可以省略签名

The merchant's PCI compliance scope and breach liability grow sharply.
Kafka no longer needs partitions.
Webhooks can skip signing.

scenario: Kafka 保存热事件 7-30 天，但金融审计可能多年后还要查看完整支付历史。
q: 长期审计数据应该如何保存？

只保存在应用内存里
把 Kafka 事件归档到 S3 对象存储
打印到控制台

why_en: Kafka is a hot event log, while long-term compliance history belongs in durable object storage archives.

Keep everything only in application memory.
Archive Kafka events to S3 object storage.
Print events to the console.

q_en: How should long-term audit data be stored?
scenario_en: Kafka keeps hot events for seven to thirty days, but financial audits may need complete payment history years later.
optionExplanations: Kafka 默认只保留 7-30 天的热事件，当成永久存储会在保留期后丢数据。
应用内存易失，进程一重启或崩溃数据就没了，撑不起长期审计。
把 Kafka 事件归档到 S3 这类对象存储，能用低成本满足多年后仍要查完整支付历史的要求。
控制台输出既不可搜索也不持久，没法支撑合规查询。
optionExplanations_en: Kafka keeps hot events for only about 7 to 30 days by default; treating it as permanent storage loses data once that window passes.
Application memory is volatile — a restart or crash wipes it out, nowhere near durable enough for long-term audit.
Archiving Kafka events to object storage like S3 meets a years-later full-history audit requirement at low cost.
Console output is neither searchable nor durable — it can't support a compliance query.

why_en: Strong payment-system answers emphasize card-data isolation, uncertainty-aware reconciliation, and immutable audit history.
options_en: Sensitive card data never touches merchant servers.
A timeout is an unknown outcome that needs idempotency and reconciliation.
Every failure should immediately be marked failed.
Current state and immutable audit history are layered separately.
q_en: Which points should a strong payment-system interview answer proactively cover? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: 敏感卡数据不碰商户服务器，是高信号候选人会主动强调的安全边界设计。
承认超时是未知态、需要靠幂等和对账收敛，是应对异步支付网络的核心思路。
把所有失败都直接标 failed，正是会造成双扣或漏履约的反面做法。
当前状态和不可变审计历史分层存储，是同时支撑低延迟查询和长期审计的关键设计。

Recognizing a timeout as an unknown outcome that needs idempotency and reconciliation is the core mindset for an asynchronous payment network.
Marking every failure as failed outright is exactly the anti-pattern that causes duplicate charges or missed fulfillment.
Layering current state apart from immutable audit history is what supports both low-latency queries and long-term audit at once.

客户卡数据通过安全 iframe/加密 token 提交

why: 主路径先建立收款意图，再安全收集卡数据并处理外部网络，最后用提交事件驱动状态查询、审计和通知。
why_en: The payment path creates an intent, securely collects card data, processes the network attempt, emits committed events, and exposes the result to merchants.

q_en: What is the correct end-to-end main path for one payment?

scenario: 一笔卡支付要走授权、捕获、结算多个阶段，每个阶段都可能单独失败，而已经捕获的钱无法靠回滚事务收回。
scenario_en: A card payment moves through authorization, capture and settlement; each stage can fail on its own, and money already captured cannot be pulled back by rolling back a transaction.
q: 多阶段支付流程的状态与失败该怎么管理？
q_en: How should state and failure be managed across a multi-stage payment flow?
options: 把三个阶段包进一个横跨支付网络的分布式事务，全成功才提交
为每个阶段单独记录状态，失败时重试或触发补偿动作
只记录最终成功或失败，中间阶段不落库
任一阶段失败就整笔标 failed，让商户换新 PaymentIntent 重来
options_en: Wrap all three stages in one distributed transaction spanning the payment network and commit only if everything succeeds.
Persist state per stage, then retry or run a compensating action when one fails.
Only record the final success or failure and keep intermediate stages out of the database.
Mark the whole payment failed on any stage failure and make the merchant start over with a new PaymentIntent.
optionExplanations: 支付网络是外部系统，不参与我们的两阶段提交，跨网络的分布式事务根本无法成立。
每个阶段各自持久化状态后就能单独重试；不可回滚的阶段用一个反向动作来补偿。
不落中间状态，重试时就无从判断钱是否已被授权，双扣风险全留给自己。
捕获已经成功却整笔标 failed，客户被扣的钱不会自动退回，还会诱发重复下单。
optionExplanations_en: The payment network is an external system that will never join our two-phase commit, so a distributed transaction across it cannot exist.
Persisting each stage lets it be retried alone, and stages that cannot be rolled back get a reverse action instead.
Without intermediate state, a retry cannot tell whether the money was already authorized, leaving you exposed to double charges.
Failing the whole payment after a successful capture does not return the customer's money and invites a duplicate order.
why: 外部网络不提供跨阶段回滚，只能让状态机逐段推进，失败处按需重试或补偿。代价是每个阶段都要写重试与反向动作，编排复杂度显著上升。
why_en: Payment networks give you no cross-stage rollback, so you advance a state machine stage by stage with retries and compensations, and you pay for that in orchestration complexity.
tradeoff: 逐阶段可重试可补偿 vs 单一事务语义更简单但外部网络不支持
whenOtherWins: 如果整条链路都在我们自己的数据库里、没有外部网络参与，一个 ACID 事务就够了，不必做补偿编排。

termDefinitions.meaning: authorization：向发卡行确认额度并冻结资金，但钱还没真正划走。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Authorization asks the issuing bank to reserve funds; the money has not actually moved yet.

termDefinitions.meaning: capture：把已授权的额度真正扣走，资金开始向商户流动。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Capture actually collects the previously authorized amount and starts moving funds to the merchant.

termDefinitions.meaning: settlement：支付网络按批次把资金真正清算到商户账户。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Settlement is when the payment network actually clears funds into the merchant's account in batches.

termDefinitions.meaning: compensation：用一个反向业务动作（如退款）抵消已完成的步骤。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Compensation undoes a completed step with a reverse business action such as a refund.

scenario: 卡号已经在我们域名的 iframe 里收集，商户服务器碰不到卡号；但安全评审仍要求 SDK 在浏览器里先用公钥加密再发出。
scenario_en: Card numbers are already collected inside an iframe served from our domain so merchant servers never touch them, yet the security review still requires the SDK to encrypt with a public key inside the browser.
q: iframe 隔离之后为什么还要端上加密？
q_en: Why add client-side encryption on top of iframe isolation?
options: iframe 已经隔离了，加密只是为了减少后端解析开销
iframe 内卡号仍是明文，被攻破就直接泄露，加密再加一层
端上加密可以取代 HTTPS，省掉 TLS 握手带来的延迟
浏览器的同源策略已经挡住了所有已知攻击，端上加密只是走个合规形式
options_en: The iframe already isolates the data, so encryption is only about reducing backend parsing cost.
Inside the iframe the card number is still plaintext, so encryption adds a layer if the frame is compromised.
Client-side encryption can replace HTTPS and save the latency of the TLS handshake.
The browser same-origin policy already blocks every known attack, so client-side encryption is a compliance formality.
optionExplanations: 加密是为了让攻破 iframe 的人拿不到可用数据，跟后端解析开销毫无关系。
iframe 的边界由浏览器策略维持，框内数据本身没加密，公钥加密让泄露出去的只是密文。
端上加密不提供服务器身份认证，也防不住中间人改包，替代不了 TLS。
同源策略只是浏览器层的一道策略，被复杂攻击绕过时就没有第二道防线了。
optionExplanations_en: Encryption exists so that whoever breaks the iframe gets nothing usable; backend parsing cost has nothing to do with it.
The iframe boundary is only enforced by browser policy and the data inside stays plaintext, so public-key encryption means a leak yields ciphertext.
Client-side encryption authenticates no server and stops no tampering in transit, so it cannot replace TLS.
The same-origin policy is one browser-level rule, and once a sophisticated attack bypasses it there is no second line of defense.
why: iframe 的安全性完全依赖浏览器策略，框内卡号仍是明文且只靠 HTTPS 保护传输；公钥在离开设备前加密，让被攻破时也只拿到密文。代价是要维护密钥对和 HSM 解密。
why_en: The iframe's protection rests entirely on browser policy and the card data inside is still plaintext, so encrypting with our public key before it leaves the device means a compromise yields only ciphertext, at the cost of running key pairs and HSM decryption.

termDefinitions.meaning: 硬件安全模块：专用硬件，私钥不出设备，在里面完成解密和签名。

termDefinitions.meaning: 用 TLS 加密的 HTTP，保护数据在传输途中不被窃听篡改。
